Hi Emma / Jordan —

Great — appreciate the partner profile. We can get this moving this week. Summary of what I attached and next steps below.

Attachments included:
- redwood-aws-cppo-playbook.pdf (CPPO checklist, submission flow, roles)
- redwood-pricing-template.xlsx (pricing template you can upload to the AWS CPPO form)

High-level answers:
1) Seller model: For this engagement we recommend Redwood be the listed seller in the AWS CPPO and ResellCo as the channel partner — this keeps the customer billing on AWS and preserves the marketplace flow (and simplifies invoicing). If ResellCo prefers to be the listed seller we can discuss, but that adds an extra procurement step.

2) Discount guidance: For a pilot of this size (50-100 seats), we typically recommend an initial reseller discount in the 18-25% range off retail list, depending on term and any committed usage. See the pricing template for suggested line-item pricing and an expandable slab for annual vs monthly billing.

3) MAP: The playbook has a MAP template on page 6. Quick draft of milestones:
   - Day 0: CPPO pricing submitted (ResellCo + Redwood to review)
   - Day 3: AWS CPPO intake filed + partner docs attached
   - Day 7-14: AWS review/negotiation window
   - Day 14-21: Contract execution and kick-off

Action items for this week (please):
- Emma: complete the pricing_template.xlsx with ResellCo line items and return to me by EOD Thu (11 Aug).
- Jordan: confirm procurement billing preference (AWS invoice or ResellCo invoice) — we highly prefer AWS billing for pilot.
- Karthik / Sergio: can you confirm the discount slab above and approve the draft MAP so we can submit CPPO by Friday?

HubSpot: I logged a placeholder deal (RD-2026-7891-CPPO) — link in the playbook.

If that timeline works I will prepare the CPPO submission packet and loop in our AWS partner manager.

Best,
